frames.scope: URDF, MJCF and USD share these names; details in urdf_frames

parameter_notes.joint_limits: Reference-aligned opening limit 28.92 degrees (0.5047492196767601 rad). Both hinge axes +X in the base frame (native -Z); active -Y taccap_right_finger_joint is positive and taccap_left_finger_joint mimics with multiplier -1. Not an independent hardware calibration.
parameter_notes.base_inertia: 0.415 kg and box-envelope inertia retain the simulation correction for a known CAD unit mismatch.
parameter_notes.finger_and_cover_inertia: Finger values imported from CAD, not independently identified. The cover link (0.068231 kg) is removed from all formats since 2026-10-09; its mass is not redistributed.
parameter_notes.effort: 4 Nm is the existing MuJoCo actuator cap, not a certified hardware limit.
parameter_notes.velocity: 1 rad/s is an explicit URDF simulation placeholder inherited from the assembly exporter.
parameter_notes.collision_meshes: Visual and collision geometry currently share the imported CAD meshes; no new collision simplification was performed.

source.repository: Xense Robotics robosuite-based simulation model (not public)
source.asset_redistribution_note: Confirmed by Xense Robotics for the public XTac-UMI-Description release (2026-10-09)

joint_contract.reference: Master gripper source URDFs (provenance/urdf of taccap_master_description)
joint_contract.coordinate_change_from_baseline: new q_left = -old q_left; new q_right = old q_right; geometry and mounting frames unchanged
joint_contract.axis_note: Expressed in the flange/base axes (2026-10-09); the native CAD axis was [0, 0, -1]. Zero, limits and signs unchanged.

drive.status: MuJoCo baseline gains converted per-radian to per-degree; not a hardware identification

usd.mesh_layers: usd/meshes/*.usdc; base_link_with_mount and viusal_link layers are retained unreferenced

base_link.STL.operation: Remove only triangles matching Asm_link.STL in the base frame; retain all other binary STL triangle records in source order.
base_link.STL.transform_source: urdf/taccap_g1_slave_macro.xacro with_mount: inverse(asm_visual origin) * taccap_mount_joint * base_visual origin, inverted
base_link.STL.physics: Existing mass/inertia retained without re-identification; collision mesh geometry changes with the visual mesh. No contact calibration.

urdf_frames.base_definition: Gripper mounting face centre (body/Asm_link mating face) in both variants; carries the body meshes and the 0.415 kg base inertial. Same convention as robotiq_85_base_link / Franka hand / xarm_gripper_base_link.
urdf_frames.axes: +Z tool axis (native CAD +X), +Y toward the left finger (native +Y), +X toward the off-axis fingers (native -Z); taccap_eef_link has the same axes

native_cad_placement.note: Placement of the native-frame meshes (base_link, grip_left, grip_right, Asm_link uses rotation only) relative to their links; every link frame shares the base axes

with_mount.root_origin: Asm_link robot-side face centre (attaches to the arm flange)

urdf_frames.mount_geometry_evidence: Asm_link.STL: 4 x 6.5 mm through holes on 50 mm PCD at 45 deg, 26 mm centre bore, no dowel hole; mounting clocking about +Z is not determined by the mesh
urdf_frames.eef_pose_policy: Massless EEF at the centre of the closed fingertips' most distal face (vertices within 0.05 mm of the extreme; mesh-derived, identical for master and slave within 0.01 mm). Replaces the original eef [0.145, 0.0060769106, -0.017] and the interim cover-origin EEF (2026-10-09)

removed_links.slave_cover_link: viusal_link.STL geometry is contained in base_link.STL (all vertices within 2e-9 m); its imported 0.068231 kg mass/inertia is dropped from the URDF and not redistributed
removed_links.slave_body_link: Merged into taccap_base_link (2026-10-09); mesh placement and inertial expressed through origins

urdf_frames.finger_frames: Finger link frames share the base axes (joint origin rpy 0, hinge axis +X); finger meshes use rpy [0, -pi/2, 0] and inertials are re-expressed by the same axis permutation (values unchanged physically)

camera.source: Position from the CAD-marked camera point (SolidWorks measure in A3-从夹爪组件.SLDASM between the taccap_base_link origin point and the camera point: dX 0, dY 22.75 mm, dZ 61.25 mm; screenshot provided by the user 2026-10-09). The mesh dome-window axis (x -22.75 mm, y 0) agrees exactly; the point is 19.95 mm behind the window ring
camera.camera_link_origin: CAD camera point on the window axis; whether it is the optical (projection) centre is not stated by the CAD mark
camera.axes: camera_link shares the base/flange and EEF axes (+Z optical axis = tool axis, +Y left finger, +X toward the off-axis fingers); optical link rpy [0, 0, -pi/2] (REP-103: +Z optical axis, +X image right, +Y image down toward the fingers)
camera.unverified: Orientation is mesh-derived (window axis) with assumed sensor roll (image down toward the fingers); no intrinsic/extrinsic calibration. Per-device fisheye intrinsics live in the gripper firmware

urdf_frames.master_correspondence: Master <side>_follower_link == taccap_base_link: EEF, fingertips, camera and hinge axis lines agree within 0.1 mm
